svg.aria-label: A chart of real Starlink satellite elevations over Greenwich across three minutes, with the highest one at each moment highlighted, changing ten times
svg.text: how high each satellite is, seen from Greenwich, over three minutes
green: the highest satellite at each moment · orange: a change of satellite (10 in 3 minutes)

figure.figcaption: Real orbits: each grey line is one Starlink satellite rising and setting (computed by this chapter’s lab, for 2026-09-28 at 18:31 UTC). A dish that always used the highest would change satellite every 18 seconds or so.
